subject: Chemistry
description: NCERT Chemistry Class 11 & 12 - Thermodynamics and Inorganic Chemistry

concepts.name: System and Surroundings
concepts.description: Open, closed, isolated systems; state functions and state variables

concepts.name: First Law of Thermodynamics
concepts.description: Internal energy, heat (q), work (w); delta U = q + w

concepts.name: Enthalpy
concepts.description: Enthalpy of reaction; delta H = delta U + P delta V; exothermic and endothermic reactions

concepts.name: Hess Law
concepts.description: Hess Law of constant heat summation; calculating enthalpy from steps

concepts.name: Heat Capacity
concepts.description: Cp, Cv, relationship between them; q = mc delta T

concepts.name: Entropy
concepts.description: Disorder and spontaneity; delta S for physical and chemical changes; Second Law

concepts.name: Gibbs Free Energy
concepts.description: delta G = delta H minus T delta S; spontaneity criterion; equilibrium constant

concepts.name: Calorimetry
concepts.description: Bomb calorimeter; measuring heat of combustion; constant volume and pressure

concepts.name: Standard Enthalpy of Formation
concepts.description: Standard enthalpy values; calculating reaction enthalpy using formation enthalpies

concepts.name: Electronic Configuration
concepts.description: Aufbau principle, Pauli exclusion principle, Hund's rule, quantum numbers, orbitals

concepts.name: Periodic Table Trends
concepts.description: Periods and groups; atomic radius, ionization energy, electronegativity trends

concepts.name: Chemical Bonding
concepts.description: Ionic, covalent, metallic bonding; Lewis structures; VSEPR theory

concepts.name: s-Block Elements
concepts.description: Group 1 and 2 properties and reactions; sodium, potassium, magnesium, calcium compounds

concepts.name: p-Block Elements
concepts.description: Group 13-18 elements; nitrogen family, oxygen family, halogens, noble gases

concepts.name: Equation Balancing
concepts.description: Balancing chemical equations by inspection and oxidation number method

concepts.name: Stoichiometry and Mole Concept
concepts.description: Mole, Avogadro number; stoichiometric calculations; limiting reagent; percentage yield
